name: Macael (Spain)
description: Quartered blue and white, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Macael (lozengy of blue and white).
history: Macael adopted its arms and flag officially in 2005; the flag is a cloth of 2:3 quartered, the first and fourth quarters blue and the second and third white.

features.role: Macael arms — lozengy of blue and white
